title: analytics.replay.completed payload
description: A journal catch-up finished (contracts.md C-14 v1.1 and clarification v0.4). One schema for both modes: State publishes mode=recovery at start, the EPIC-005 harness mode=test. Co-owned: EPIC-002 owns the file, EPIC-005 adds the fields of mode=test.

snapshot_id.description: null when the catch-up started without a snapshot.

state_hash_before.description: state_hash of the snapshot the catch-up started from; absent without one. Same form as snapshot.created.snapshot.state_hash.

state_hash_after.description: entity.StateHash of the world after the catch-up: sha256: and 64 lowercase hex digits, compared as a string with state_hash_before (metrics.md recovery_state_identical).
